# Codebase Complete Refactor Plan And Checklist

Primary goal: make ownership correct. `scripts/main.gd` should become orchestration glue, not the owner of every runtime, UI surface, input path, save concern, and transport.

Current measured size: 21,167 lines. The below-45k checkpoint is reached, but line count is only a health metric. Continue only where a boundary becomes more correct, simpler, or more maintainable.

This is the living extraction plan. Keep it practical: each step should move one real owner out of `main.gd`, preserve behavior, name the validation, and improve the ownership map. Line reduction is useful evidence, not the reason to move code.

Definition of done: the codebase is healthy when each major system has one obvious owner, related splinter files are consolidated under that owner, `main.gd` mostly wires owners together, and validation stays green. Stop extracting when the next move would only chase line count.

Existing small extracted files are part of this cleanup too. When a new owner is created, sweep the related 20-100 line helper files and either move them under that owner, merge them into the owner, or leave them only if they are genuinely reusable across multiple owners.

## Agent Setup

Use Ponytail for every extraction agent. The point is not to be terse; the point is to prevent refactor sprawl.

The main coordinator, not the user, should dispatch future subagents. The coordinator owns sequencing, integration review, validation judgment, and deciding whether the next step is safe to start. Subagents own bounded implementation slices and report back with files changed, measured line counts, validation results, and deferred follow-up.

Each agent should follow these rules:

- Move one owner, not a theme.
- Reuse existing code and patterns before inventing a new abstraction.
- Consolidate related splinter files into the new owner instead of creating more tiny files.
- Leave UI rendering in `main.gd` unless the step explicitly says to move UI.
- Preserve save keys, action IDs, node names, asset paths, user-facing text, and Firebase paths.
- Run the listed validation, then update this doc with measured `main.gd` line count, ownership change, and notes.
- Extraction steps may remove dead/trivial wrappers only when that directly supports the owner boundary. Broader system simplification, variable model changes, and gameplay cleanup happen in follow-up passes after the owner is extracted and validated.

## Step 1: Extract Online Runtime

Move the Firebase, cloud save, leaderboard, profile reference, and chat transport code out of `scripts/main.gd` into one owner:

`scripts/online/online_runtime.gd`

Do not split this into many files yet. The lazy win is one owner with one lifecycle, not five tiny wrappers.

### Move

Move these regions together because they share auth, URLs, HTTP nodes, profile identity, and error handling:

- Firebase config and URL helpers: `_leaderboard_load_firebase_config`, `_firebase_database_url`, `_leaderboard_firebase_url`, `_chat_firebase_url`, `_cloud_save_firebase_url`.
- Google/Firebase auth helpers: `_leaderboard_ensure_auth`, `_ensure_google_auth_plugin`, `_start_google_account_sign_in`, `_exchange_google_id_token_for_firebase`, `_apply_firebase_auth_response`, and related callbacks.
- Cloud save transport: `_fetch_cloud_save`, `_upload_cloud_save`, `_on_cloud_save_fetch_completed`, `_on_cloud_save_upload_completed`, cloud-save status/summary helpers.
- Leaderboard transport: `_leaderboard_fetch_category`, `_leaderboard_submit_scores`, leaderboard fetch/auth/name-claim callbacks, row finalization/storage helpers.
- Chat transport/state helpers: `_chat_stream_connect`, `_chat_poll_messages`, `_chat_send`, chat fetch/send callbacks, stream parsing, row merge/sort/sanitize/message-id helpers.
- Profile reference sync helpers: `_refresh_profile_references`, `_refresh_local_profile_references`, `_profile_reference_updates`, `_on_profile_reference_update_completed`.

Leave chat overlay rendering, leaderboard page rendering, profile modal rendering, and nav/UI button code in `main.gd` for now. Step 1 is transport/state only.

### Shape

`OnlineRuntime` should be a `RefCounted` or child `Node`. Use a child `Node` if it needs to own `HTTPRequest` nodes or timers.

Minimum public API back to `main.gd`:

```gdscript
online_runtime.setup(self)
online_runtime.process(delta)
online_runtime.fetch_cloud_save()
online_runtime.upload_cloud_save(_save_payload(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()))
online_runtime.fetch_leaderboard_category(category_id)
online_runtime.submit_leaderboard_scores(_leaderboard_score_payloads())
online_runtime.send_chat(raw_text)
online_runtime.mark_chat_opened_to_latest(save_now)
```

Signals back to `main.gd`:

```gdscript
signal cloud_save_loaded(payload)
signal cloud_save_status_changed()
signal leaderboard_rows_changed(category_id)
signal leaderboard_status_changed()
signal chat_rows_changed()
signal chat_status_changed()
signal profile_reference_changed()
```

If a helper needs UI nodes, it does not belong in this step. Leave it in `main.gd`.

### Expected Reduction

Target reduction from `main.gd`: 2k-4k lines.

This does not finish Goal 1 by itself. It proves the extraction pattern and removes a real ownership island. After this, repeat the same pattern for audio, passive/firepit runtime, fishing runtime, and hub runtime.

### Validation

Run:

```powershell
.\scripts\check-leaderboard-cost-safety.ps1
.\scripts\test-firebase-leaderboard-config-validation.ps1
.\scripts\test-firebase-leaderboard-runtime-guard.ps1
.\scripts\check-project.ps1
```

Post-Godot check:

```powershell
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='Godot.exe'" | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,CommandLine
```

No screenshot is required unless UI rendering changes. This step should not change UI.

## Phase 2: Extract UI Owners

Runtime ownership is now started, but `main.gd` is still mostly huge UI/detail/action surfaces. Phase 2 should move visible regions only one screen family at a time. Because these steps affect player-visible layout, each agent should run focused validation plus a screenshot or existing visual smoke test when practical. Do not combine these with gameplay simplification.

| Step | Candidate owner | Main.gd region | Target reduction | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: | --- |

| 8 | Fishing UI surface | fishing location/tool/method tiles, fishing lazy plan, active camera/animation | 1k-3k | Follow Step 4 runtime owner; do not change fishing data. |
| 9 | Profile/chat/achievement overlays | profile overlay, chat composer, achievements overlay/page | 1k-2k | Overlay rendering only; online transport stays in `OnlineRuntime`. |
| 10 | Save/load owner | `_save_payload`, `_load_game_core`, `_init_state`, offline restore/apply helpers | 500-1.5k | Keep save keys exactly stable. |

## Planning Notes

- Prefer one owner per extraction, not many tiny helper files.
- Consolidate existing splinter files into the new owners created by this plan when they clearly belong there.
- If extracted code still reaches deeply into `main.gd` state, the boundary is not done.
- UI extraction comes after runtime extraction unless the UI region is already isolated.
- Update this doc after each landed step with measured `main.gd` line count and validation results.
